name: Feeds Crawler Fetcher
description: Adds a Feeds fetcher plugin (id 'crawler', 'Crawl a set of url') that downloads a newline-separated list of URLs as one import, with optional simple page substitution via a <page> placeholder.
project_description: Feeds Crawler Fetcher provides one extra fetcher plugin for the Feeds import framework: 'Crawl a set of url' (plugin id 'crawler'). Instead of a single feed source URL, the feed's source is a textarea holding one URL per line; on import the fetcher downloads every listed URL server-side with the core HTTP client and combines the responses into a single result file that the configured parser then processes. It can optionally expand a simple page range: when 'Paged Fetcher' is enabled and a URL contains the literal '<page>' token, the token is replaced with 0..(Total Pages - 1) and each page is fetched in turn. Responses are combined either as JSON (successive responses are json-decoded and array-merged) or as HTML (responses are concatenated with FILE_APPEND), selected by the 'Type of information' fetcher option. Despite the 'crawl' name it does not discover or follow links found in the fetched content; it only requests the static, admin-configured URL list. It requires the Feeds module (dependency not declared in the .info.yml).
